verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada runs online services such as the Online Filing Centre, so whether users can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers analytics, cookies, telemetry or any opt-out control. The cited items deal only with incorporation steps, fees, annual returns and an open-data API probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
